title: mon_needs reads the low-disk threshold from the host alert's constant
goal: mon_needs takes its low-disk percentage from mon_host's constant instead of a copy, so the needs-you line and the host alert change together

run:
import sys,inspect;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_needs
sys.exit(1 if 'LOW_DISK_PCT = ' in inspect.getsource(mon_needs) else 0)
